content:
We would like to announce our project formalising the classification of the groups of order p * q where p and q are (not necessarily distinct) prime numbers.

Currently, mathlib only contains the classifications of groups of prime order and groups of order 4. Our project is another step forward in classifying finite groups of specific orders.

The source code of the project is available at https://github.com/wupr/order-p-q.
We plan to merge most of the code into mathlib. Comments are welcome in the meantime.
